notes: Current maker page is the Bosch Smart System version (545Wh on-tube battery, Purion 200). Maker page on sale ($2,499); regular $2,899 recorded. Maker gives no e-bike class, no max load, no rated motor watts, and weight only 'excl. battery' (battery weight not given). Range is per assist mode (Eco 95 / Tour 60 / Auto 45 / Turbo 40 mi). Rider height and per-mode range values are not returned by the standard script (no regex match), so quotes join consecutive page lines with ' | '. electricbikereview.com has only a 2019 Medeo T9 review (396Wh rack battery, older Bosch system) and a 'Medeo T9 City HMB' review — older generation/different model, not used. electricbikereport.com has only a 2024 'Medeo T9 City' review — different model, not used. REI search returned 'Access to this page has been denied' (HTTP 403, bot check). Best Buy search had no Medeo listing. Used two US dealer pages found via web search instead: Fly Rides USA (High Step, MY 2025) and Angry Catfish (Low Step, Smart System); they confirm price/torque/battery only. | recheck: maker product page has no class line, but Gazelle's US 'Class 1 eBikes' collection page lists the Medeo T9 (and Medeo T9 City, Easyflow C7).
